the loss of the NF2 protein (also known as Merlin) is the cause of the formation of retinal and nerve tissue lesions in neurofibromatose 2 patients.

the NF2 gene plays a role in the formation of retinal and nerve lesions in neurofibromatossis patients, but that the iris lesions may be unrelated to the NF2 gene.
